name: opencode-go-dashboard
author: jiaheng6
description: 在本机集中查看多个 OpenCode Go 账号的套餐余量

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --universal --publish never
